titulo: Three ways to review a draft
caption:
Three ways to review a draft

I used to say looks great to every draft I was shown. Then I started naming the page that dragged.

Praise with no detail gives a writer nothing to change, and one specific note is easier to use than a long list.

For whoever gives one specific note.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A blue-gray room with a table and an orange book standing on it, and a blue figure that asks thoughts on this? in each of three labeled scenes. The pat: a teal figure says looks great! and the blue one narrows its eyes. The pile: a brown figure says redo it all. and the blue one looks down, wide-eyed. The one note: an ink-black figure tilts its head and says page two drags., the book opens, and the blue one answers with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of giving feedback. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
